subject: Presence plot with axis as factors

messages.author: 91de45515cb16445
messages.subject: Presence plot with axis as factors
parts:
Hi,

I am not sure what the name is for the type of plot I want to make so it is hard to troubleshoot it.  I want on the y axis to be a category, for example type of cars, then on the x axis years.  I want dots to represent the presence and size of the number of car types for each year.  Years with no car types would not have a circle.  So my data str is
data.frame: 145: of 3 variables:
Year: factor with 29 levels
Make: factor with 4 levels
Total: int

I looked in O'Reilly's book but didn't see anything like I describe. How would I make such a graph?
Thanks

messages.author: 9c9b5f9c6aaa025d
messages.subject: Re: Presence plot with axis as factors
parts:
Seems like you want at something using `geom_point` with the size aesthetic set to `Total`, like 

ggplot(dta) + geom_point(aes(x = Year, y = Make, size = Total))
